tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the trade room panel, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chat bubbles from the other party, selected rows. Sits on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders and dividers that carry meaning. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on ground, surface and surface-raised. Also the focus ring and every selected state: a 2px ink border on surface-raised for selected tiles, chips, radio cards and segments, ink checks and ink radio dots.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, fiat equivalents on ground, surface and surface-raised (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: monero
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Fill for the ONE primary action per screen (Fund, I'm in, I've paid, Received) and brand marks. Never a selected state (use ink). Never body text on Day grounds; use monero-ink for orange text.

tokens.name: monero-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text and icons: links, the active tab, the XMR unit label. Reads 4.5:1+ on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-monero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a monero fill (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: escrow
tokens.usage: Escrow secured, releasable, released and completed states. Text and icons on ground, surface and surface-raised. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Green for a good or strong state in words: "Strong" on the sign-up login methods, a recovery code typed back correctly (lead call, 12 Nov 2026, on the owner's "strong in green letters"). Text on ground, surface and surface-raised, 6:1+ in both themes. For design to adjust.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Waiting states: Securing escrow, payment timer running, awaiting confirmation. Text and icons on ground and surfaces. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Disputes, scam warnings, destructive actions. Text and icons on ground and surfaces. Always paired with a word; differs from monero in hue and from escrow off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: monero-ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour for orange (monero-ink) links. Taken from the X2F App boards (a:hover). Day value: lead choice, owner may adjust.

tokens.name: mod
tokens.usage: Violet, only for moderators: the X2F Moderator tag, moderator tiles and names, inside disputes and the staff app only. Taken from the X2F App boards (design kit handoff: --mod). Day value: lead choice, owner may adjust.

tokens.name: team
tokens.usage: Team members: their sessions on Devices, their rows on Team, "replied by a team member" in chat. From the design conventions (2 Nov 2026): members' cards take a 10% team tint, a 45% team border and initials avatars on team.

scrims.name: scrim
scrims.usage: Behind sheets and modal dialogs (design kit handoff 1.1). The only non-hex colour, allowed because it lives in the token file.

families.display: "DM Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.sans: "DM Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "Roboto Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen heroes and empty states. One per screen at most.

styles.name: result-headline
styles.usage: Design kit handoff 1.4: the hero of a result screen on phone (Refunded). Wide: the display style (40/44).

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.sample: Choose a device to log out
styles.usage: Visual system v2 (2 Nov 2026): bottom sheet and dialog titles, and the headline of a result step.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Visual system v2 (2 Nov 2026): the title of a key screen (trade, setup, result, the new-device approval).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Send the payment, then tap I've paid.
styles.usage: All running text and chat. 18px since the owner's 16 Nov font decision (DM Sans, bigger text); 17px from the 12 Nov demo note #43.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status chips, field labels, table headers. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: Design kit handoff 1.4: the one big amount or timer per screen. Its unit is in body type, 18/24 600 muted.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Trade amounts and totals. Tabular figures. Always show XMR with 6 decimals and the fiat total beside it.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Wallet addresses, PGP fingerprints, transaction IDs. Chunk in groups of 4 characters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls and list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Visual system v2: gap inside a tight list; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Visual system v2: primary and outline card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; dot pitch of the 2-of-3 motif.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Visual system v2: the top of the spacing scale (wide content padding).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, proof thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Design kit handoff 1.3: stat tiles, 32 px moderator and system tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner blocks, buttons, callouts, icon tiles (visual system v2; before v2 also cards and sheets).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Visual system v2 (2 Nov 2026): primary cards, the hero, upload rows, sheet tops, 56 px state tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, timers, avatar rings.
